words.gloss_range: resumptive or coordinating connector opening the Day-frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular temporal noun opening the Day-frame

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation into the Day-scene, not as an isolated timestamp. Its attachment to {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) lets the prior evaluation in 18:46 carry into the upheaval of 18:47, so the boundary joins value-language to judgment-scene. The clipped particle also gives a light pickup before the heavier temporal and mountain vocabulary.

topics.headline: connected launch into the Day-scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the judgment scene grows out of the previous ayah rather than beginning as detached scenery.
topics.reason: QAC allows coordination or resumption, and the attachment evidence marks the opening as a temporal scene, so the CRITICAL boundary and scope rows survive.

topics.headline: short onset before heavier scene words
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a quick entry into the scene before the verse moves into heavier nouns and verbs.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is modest but locally coherent with the single-letter proclitic before the temporal noun.

words.gloss_range: singular accusative temporal frame for the whole eschatological scene
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers day, time-period, occasion, and condition; local context selects the decisive judgment occasion
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) is the singular accusative time-frame that contains the whole chain: mountains moved, earth exposed, people gathered, and no one omitted. Its case can also imply a recalled scene, as though the listener is being told to bring that Day before attention. The broader day/time range is narrowed here by the mountain-motion and gathering context into the eschatological occasion, a Day whose reality is witnessed on the exposed ground.

topics.headline: one Day-frame holds every following clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not four scattered events but one bounded Day-scene with escalating beats.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) as an accusative temporal adverb attached to {{ar:نُسَيِّرُ}} ({{tr:nusayyiru}}), supporting the CRITICAL claim that it frames the scene.

topics.headline: implied recall governs the temporal opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the Day summoned into view after 18:46 rather than merely dated in advance.
topics.reason: The ellipsis evidence licenses an implied governing recall verb for the temporal opening, preserving the CRITICAL rows about summons and boundary transition.

topics.headline: ordinary day narrowed to judgment occasion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that the word's broad time-range is locally narrowed into a judgment occasion marked by mountain motion, witnessing, and gathering.
topics.reason: The root can cover ordinary day or period, but the local collocations with mountain motion, seeing, earth, and gathering select the eschatological Day sense; cross-references such as 52:10, 78:20, and 81:3 support the formula without controlling every detail.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect: We cause to move or set in motion within the Day-frame
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes travel, movement, flowing, driving, and operation; local Form II with mountains selects compelled mobilization of fixed terrain
words.prose: {{ar:نُسَيِّرُ}} ({{tr:nusayyiru}}) makes the first event an active divine causation: the mountains do not simply travel, they are made to move. The imperfect presents that undoing as in progress inside the Day-frame, before the later perfect gathering is stated as accomplished. The root's travel, flow, and driven-motion range sharpens the image of fixed terrain being forcibly mobilized, while local grammar keeps the selected sense to caused mountain movement rather than free human travel or autonomous motion.

topics.headline: Form II makes mountains undergo divine motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the most stable terrain is grammatically made a patient of divine causation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form II imperfect with first-person plural subject and an explicit mountain object, so the CRITICAL contrast with passive or intransitive variants survives.

topics.headline: imperfect aspect keeps the dismantling visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mountain removal as an unfolding process rather than a completed background fact.
topics.reason: The imperfect form in the temporal frame supports the CRITICAL aspect contrast with the later perfect gathering.

topics.headline: travel and flow range narrowed to forced mountain mobilization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reversal: what normally marks fixity is driven into motion, with flow or banishment imagery only coloring that local movement.
topics.reason: The root range supports travel, flow, and driven movement, but the explicit object {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالَ}} ({{tr:al-jibāla}}) narrows the payoff to compelled destabilization of mountains; modern operation senses remain secondary color, not the local sense.

words.gloss_range: definite plural mountains as the accusative object of caused motion
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on mountains and formed solidity, with related formation or innate-constitution pressure narrowed here to real mountains as stable created forms
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالَ}} ({{tr:al-jibāla}}) is definite, plural, and accusative: the known class of mountains is the object being moved. Variant pressure that would make the mountains a nominative subject highlights the local Hafs force: they are directly acted upon. The root's formed-solidity and constitution range gives the scene more than scenery; real mountains, the icons of created stability, become mobile within a wider Quranic mountain-motion field, including echoes such as 52:10, 78:20, and 81:3.

topics.headline: definite plural mountains as acted-upon class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole recognizable mountain class is treated as a direct patient, not as a self-moving subject.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالَ}} ({{tr:al-jibāla}}) as accusative direct object of {{ar:نُسَيِّرُ}} ({{tr:nusayyiru}}), preserving the CRITICAL case and affectedness rows.

topics.headline: formed solidity becomes movable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the undoing of created solidity, while still reading the word as real mountains in the scene.
topics.reason: The j-b-l field includes formation and innate constitution, but local grammar and object status keep the reference to mountains; the broader formation pressure survives as a narrowed image of stability undone.

topics.headline: mountain motion as judgment-scene marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the moved mountains as part of a recurring Quranic sign of cosmic destabilization, not a decorative landscape detail.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and echo rows place mountain motion across eschatological contexts; local pairing with exposed earth and gathering specializes that field.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector from mountain motion to perception
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the seeing clause to the mountain-motion clause. The exposed earth is not a detached new episode; it is coordinated with the same eschatological moment. The hinge also shifts the grammar from mountains as acted-upon object to the addressee as witness.

topics.headline: mountain action joined to visual witnessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cosmic action and visual perception are paired beats in one scene.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the seeing clause with the mountain-motion clause, so the CRITICAL simultaneity and hinge rows survive.

words.gloss_range: second-person singular imperfect seeing directed at the exposed earth
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers seeing, perceiving, judging, opinion, and vision; local object and state select direct visual witnessing with recognition pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) turns the scene toward a singular witness: the addressee sees the earth in its exposed state. The r-ʾ-y range can include sight, judgment, opinion, and vision, but the direct object and state phrase narrow it here to visual witnessing that forces recognition. The same verb returns with the record in 18:49, so seeing moves from exposed ground to exposed accounting.

topics.headline: singular addressee made witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic scene is grammatically brought before a direct singular witness.
topics.reason: QAC and implicit-argument evidence mark a second masculine singular imperfect subject, while the passive variant rows clarify the local witness remains explicit.

topics.headline: sight range narrowed to evidentiary recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the seeing as direct evidence of reality, not mere looking or private opinion.
topics.reason: The root range includes nonvisual perception and causing-to-see family pressure, but the explicit object {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) and its state select direct visual perception with recognition force.

topics.headline: seeing links exposed earth and exposed record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of seeing in 18:47 prepares the later sight of the record in 18:49.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo rows explicitly connect {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) in 18:47 with the seeing of the record in 18:49, so the inter-ayah payoff survives.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth or ground-plane as the direct object of seeing
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes earth, land, territory, low spread ground, and stability or quaking associations; local contrast with mountains selects the exposed ground-plane

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: active participle describing the earth as exposed

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) is the direct object of seeing and the noun whose feminine singular features control {{ar:بَارِزَةً}} ({{tr:bārizatan}}). The definite singular presents one recognizable ground-plane rather than scattered territories. The root's low, spread-ground pressure becomes pointed after the mountains: high fixed forms move away, and the low substrate appears as the middle platform between cosmic dismantling and human gathering.

topics.headline: earth as seen object and bearer of exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is both what is seen and the specific bearer of the exposed state.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) as the direct object of {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) and head of the circumstantial state {{ar:بَارِزَةً}} ({{tr:bārizatan}}).

topics.headline: low substrate revealed after mountains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a vertical reversal: elevated forms are moved and the low ground-plane is exposed.
topics.reason: The root range can include land or territory, but local contrast with {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالَ}} ({{tr:al-jibāla}}) narrows the payoff to low spread ground revealed beneath elevation.

topics.headline: earth mediates cosmic and human beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth as the stage where cosmic exposure turns toward human assembly.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL position rows match the ayah architecture: the earth clause sits between moving mountains and gathering people.

words.gloss_range: feminine singular accusative active participle as the earth’s circumstantial exposed state
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers appearing, emerging, becoming manifest, open exposed land, and coming forward for confrontation; local grammar selects the earth standing exposed
words.prose: {{ar:بَارِزَةًۭ}} ({{tr:bārizatan}}) is an accusative active participle functioning as the state of the earth. Its feminine singular agreement keeps the exposure attached to {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}), not to the mountains. The root makes the exposure manifest rather than merely empty: the ground stands out into open visibility, and the participial form gives it a confronting presence; comparisons with people coming forth, such as 40:16, remain an echo, not a replacement for the local earth-state.

topics.headline: active participial state of the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exposure is grammatically the earth's state, actively presented as standing forth.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:بَارِزَةًۭ}} ({{tr:bārizatan}}) as an active participle and circumstantial accusative describing {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}).

topics.headline: open visibility after concealment removed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ground as manifest and unconcealed, not just vacant or flat.
topics.reason: The b-r-z evidence supports appearing, open country, and exposure, matching the local state after the mountains are moved.

topics.headline: earth borrows the coming-forth pressure used of persons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the unusual force of the earth itself standing forth, while the local referent remains the ground rather than people.
topics.reason: Rows comparing person-disclosure and earth-disclosure survive as an echo; local agreement and attachment keep the participle on the earth, while 40:16 shows the broader coming-forth field.

words.gloss_range: connector from exposed landscape to human gathering
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the gathering clause to the exposed-earth scene while also marking the major pivot from landscape to people. The ayah does not leave cosmic disclosure as spectacle; by this connector, the exposed ground becomes the setting for human assembly.

topics.headline: connector turns exposed landscape toward people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse pivots from terrain to human accountability without breaking the Day-scene.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:وَحَشَرْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:wa-ḥasharnāhum}}) with the preceding Day events, while the CRITICAL rows preserve the pivot from landscape to assembly.

words.gloss_range: perfect first-person plural verb with object suffix: We gathered them
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes gathering, driving, crowding, and compelled assembly; local perfect form presents completed divine collection of the human group
words.prose: {{ar:حَشَرْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:ḥasharnāhum}}) shifts from visible terrain to human assembly. The perfect form inside the future Day-frame states the gathering as accomplished certainty, contrasting with the unfolding imperfect of mountain motion. The root's driving and crowding pressure makes the assembly compulsory rather than voluntary, while the attached suffix carries the evaluated human world from 18:46 into one collected object. The same-surah gathering thread also reaches toward 18:99, where another end-time divine gathering is stated.

topics.headline: perfect aspect secures the future gathering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human assembly is grammatically secured as completed while the cosmic dismantling is shown unfolding.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect first-person plural verb in a future Day-frame, preserving the CRITICAL taḥqīq and aspect-contrast rows.

topics.headline: gathering as driven compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that the people are driven into assembly, not invited into a neutral meeting.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports gathering with driving, crowding, and constraint; local divine subject and object suffix keep that pressure in the judgment assembly.

topics.headline: suffix makes evaluated humans the gathered object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the human group from prior evaluation into the gathering without waiting for a new noun.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the suffix as the object, and cross-reference evidence resolves it as the gathered people in the eschatological scene.

topics.headline: gathering thread returns later in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this early judgment gathering to the later same-surah gathering scene in 18:99.
topics.reason: The supplied echo rows explicitly compare 18:47 with 18:99, so the same-surah gathering thread survives as a candidate payoff.

words.gloss_range: result or immediate-sequence connector before the non-omission clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the no-omission clause the immediate result and verification of gathering. The verse moves from collection to completeness: the gathering is defined by the fact that no one is left behind. Its fusion with {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) makes consequence and categorical negation arrive together.

topics.headline: result particle turns gathering into a completeness check
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no-omission is not an afterthought but the result that verifies gathering.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final clause as result of the gathering, supporting the CRITICAL rows about immediate sequence, consequence, and the pivot to totality.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator with categorical scope over leaving anyone behind

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negated jussive verb for leaving behind or omitting

words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) opens the final totality clause by negating {{ar:نُغَادِرْ}} ({{tr:nughādir}}) and carrying that negation through {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) and {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}). In the future Day-frame, its past-style jussive negation presents omission as already and categorically denied. The grammar of the negator is visible in the jussive verb, so non-omission is not just a lexical idea but a governed clause structure.

topics.headline: negation reaches every member of the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that omission is denied categorically across the whole final clause, down to any one person.
topics.reason: Translation-support evidence explicitly warns that the negation plus partitive phrase expresses exhaustive non-omission, preserving the CRITICAL scope rows.

topics.headline: negator governs the verb form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial carried by grammar itself, with result and negation fused before the verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs the jussive {{ar:نُغَادِرْ}} ({{tr:nughādir}}), supporting the form-governance rows.

words.gloss_range: Form III jussive under negation: We leave behind or omit
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes leaving behind, abandoning, breach or betrayal, and omission; local negated Form III selects exhaustive non-omission with ethical undertone
words.prose: {{ar:نُغَادِرْ}} ({{tr:nughādir}}) is the jussive verb governed by {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), and it carries both the partitive domain {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) and the direct object {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}). Its first-person plural keeps the non-omission divine. The gh-d-r field is narrowed locally to leaving behind or omitting, but its abandonment and breach pressure makes the denial ethical as well as administrative: no person is left as a remnant outside the gathering. The same root returns in 18:49 for the record, so no person omitted in 18:47 anticipates no deed omitted in 18:49.

topics.headline: jussive verb carries group and individual arguments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb checks both the gathered group and the single individual under explicit divine agency.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:نُغَادِرْ}} ({{tr:nughādir}}) as governed by {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), linked to {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}), and taking {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}) as object.

topics.headline: leaving-behind sense carries breach pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that non-omission is faithful and comprehensive, not merely a clean count.
topics.reason: The local sense is leaving behind under negation; betrayal and breach senses remain as narrowed ethical pressure, while variant and form rows support the explicit Form III divine non-omission rather than a different causative or passive parse.

topics.headline: no person omitted anticipates no deed omitted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects total gathering in 18:47 with total accounting in 18:49 through the same gh-d-r root.
topics.reason: The supplied rows explicitly connect {{ar:نُغَادِرْ}} ({{tr:nughādir}}) in 18:47 with {{ar:يُغَادِرُ}} ({{tr:yughādiru}}) in 18:49, preserving the gathering-to-record echo.

words.gloss_range: partitive prepositional phrase: from among them

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) defines the domain tested by the negation: from among them. Placed before {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}), it moves the closure from group to individual unit. The suffix repeats the gathered human referent from {{ar:حَشَرْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:ḥasharnāhum}}), so the no-omission claim applies to the same people already assembled.

topics.headline: group-domain before the single exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first defines the whole group-domain and then denies even one exception within it.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation-support evidence identify the phrase as partitive complement and warn that it creates exhaustive scope under negation.

topics.headline: same gathered people remain in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one continuous human referent from gathering to no-omission.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence links the suffix in {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) to the gathered group named by the suffix in {{ar:حَشَرْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:ḥasharnāhum}}).

words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on oneness and any-one force; local negation universalizes the singular into zero exception

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negated jussive verb for leaving behind or omitting

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}) is the accusative object of the negated leaving-behind verb. As an indefinite singular under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), it means not even one, so the cosmic scene lands on the individual exception that is denied. The word completes the no-person-left formula with {{ar:نُغَادِرْ}} ({{tr:nughādir}}), and its later recurrence in 18:49 links no one omitted with no one wronged.

topics.headline: not a single individual under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how one singular object becomes universal under negation: not a single person is left.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}) as accusative object, and translation-support confirms exhaustive non-omission under negation.

topics.headline: ayah closes on the denied exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verse close from cosmic scale down to the level of one person, with zero exception left standing.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}) to the gh-d-r no-omission pair and to the final cadence, preserving the individualizing closure.

topics.headline: final any-one echoes later non-wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final any-one of 18:47 with the final any-one of 18:49, moving from no one omitted to no one wronged.
topics.reason: The supplied echo rows explicitly connect the final {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}) in 18:47 with the final {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadā}}) in 18:49.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-6: caused mountain motion followed by the earth becoming exposed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The normally elevated, solid relief is forcibly displaced, removing occlusion and turning the lower terrain into one open field.

activation_trace.role: This removal or expulsion branch makes caused motion function as clearance of the terrain.
The elevated solid mass supplies the obstructing relief that is cleared.
The lower surface opposite the sky becomes the continuous substrate revealed by clearance.
The uncovered wide-space branch turns visibility into an unshielded spatial condition.

changed_reading.before: Mountains travel and the earth happens to be visible.
changed_reading.after: Mountain motion is a clearing operation that unroofs the lower world into a single exposed field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 7-11: gathering them while leaving not one of them behind.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispersed population is driven to one destination, and the negative construction closes every possible remainder at the individual level.

activation_trace.role: Gathering with directed driving supplies convergence toward a common destination.
Leaving something behind supplies the remainder operation that the negation cancels.
The negative-polarity branch makes the cancellation exhaustive across every eligible person.

changed_reading.before: A very large crowd is assembled.
changed_reading.after: Every individual is extracted from dispersion and delivered to one destination with zero human remainder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full sequence: fixed masses move, hidden ground appears, and dispersed humans are concentrated.
baseline_models.mechanism: Three coordinated state reversals abolish ordinary spatial security: the immovable moves, the covered becomes visible, and the mobile multitude can no longer remain dispersed.

activation_trace.role: Hard ground that stops penetration supplies the focus image's normal condition of fixity.
Caused travel reverses the mountain's resistant fixity.
Emergence after concealment supplies the second reversal from hidden to manifest.
Directed gathering supplies the third reversal from human dispersion to concentration.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists separate end-time events.
changed_reading.after: The events form one engineered reversal of spatial statuses that eliminates stability, cover, and dispersion together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier earth first bears growth, then its cover becomes brittle residue and is wind-scattered; the focus scales that stripping logic upward by removing even the mountains and exposing the substrate.

activation_trace.role: Productive ground supplies the initially clothed surface whose later bareness becomes consequential.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the disintegrated surface cover.
Wind-winnowing supplies the removal process that carries the broken cover away.
Removal or expulsion extends surface stripping to the mountains.
The elevated solid mass is the final and largest layer removed.
Emergence from concealment is the resulting condition of the stripped earth.

structural_cues: 18:45 moves from earth-grown cover to broken residue scattered away; 18:47 repeats the earth after mountain removal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: vegetal cover is broken and dispersed before mountains are displaced and earth is exposed. Reader arrow: both sequences instantiate stripping at different scales. Alternative: the two scenes may only juxtapose impermanence rather than share a physical process.

changed_reading.before: The exposed earth results only from a sudden topographic event.
changed_reading.after: The scene is the terminal scale of a stripping sequence: growth-cover, debris, and finally relief itself are removed until only substrate remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bare field becomes a presentation surface: gathering is not mere crowding but visible arrangement in a level line, with acquired distinctions reset by the return to first-created condition.

activation_trace.role: Open uncovered space supplies the presentation ground.
Directed gathering delivers the population onto that ground.
Bringing something out for inspection turns the assembly into a public presentation.
Alignment on an even line supplies the assembly's ordered geometry.
Origination supplies the reset condition under which acquired rank no longer organizes the rows.

structural_cues: The focus's exposed earth and total gathering are immediately followed by display, row formation, and return as at first creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an uncovered field, total gathering, display, rows, and first creation occur in sequence. Reader arrow: clearance enables inspectable and comparable array. Alternative: row formation may describe order without implying the field was cleared for that purpose.

changed_reading.before: All people are collected somewhere on the changed earth.
changed_reading.after: The earth is cleared into an inspection plane on which every person is publicly arrayed under a reset of worldly distinctions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same non-omission logic governs two inventories: no person remains outside the gathering, and no deed remains outside enumeration and presence.

activation_trace.role: Directed collection supplies the complete inventory of persons.
The negated leaving-behind operation closes the person inventory.
Exhaustive negation resolves completeness down to every person.
The repeated leaving-behind operation transfers the same completeness test to deeds.
Exhaustive counting supplies item-by-item closure of the deed inventory.
Presence and witnessed nearness make recorded deeds co-present with their doers.
The second exhaustive individual term keeps adjudication person-specific.

structural_cues: The focus's negated leaving of any person is echoed by the book's negated leaving of anything small or great, followed by deeds found present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same leave-nothing frame governs persons and recorded acts, with acts then present. Reader arrow: the two exhaustive inventories are synchronized for audit. Alternative: the repetition may emphasize completeness independently without specifying a single audit mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The gathering is exhaustive only in population.
changed_reading.after: Each gathered person is paired with an equally exhaustive, present inventory of action; neither agent nor act can remain off-field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Total bodily co-presence does not restore protective relations: claimed partners do not answer, a destructive separator stands between, the destination becomes visible, and no turning route remains.

activation_trace.role: Directed gathering supplies physical co-presence.
Individuality within the totality preserves each person's solitary exposure.
Claimed partnership supplies the expected rescue relation.
The absent verbal response marks failure of that relation at the point of appeal.
Separation and severance convert togetherness into relational distance.
A barrier between parties gives the failed relation a spatial form.
Direct sight makes the terminal encounter perceptually unavoidable.
The unavailable turning-away branch closes the last evasive route.

structural_cues: 18:52 runs from appeal to nonresponse to a barrier; 18:53 runs from sight of the destination to failure to find a way of turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: everyone is gathered, partners fail to answer, separation is imposed, and no diversion is found. Reader arrow: physical convergence intensifies rather than cures relational isolation. Alternative: partner failure and route failure may concern only cultic reliance and punishment, not the geometry of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Universal gathering implies an undifferentiated collective crowd.
changed_reading.after: Everyone is physically together yet individually unrescued; the assembly is maximal co-presence combined with severed support and no exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier refusal works through turning away, forgetting, protective covering, and sensory weight; the focus reverses that regime by making the field visible and every person externally present.

activation_trace.role: Direct perception supplies the focus's compulsory visibility.
Disclosure after concealment supplies the reversal's outward state.
Turning one's side away supplies deliberate perceptual refusal.

A protective cover supplies the cognitive enclosure opposed by external disclosure.
Auditory heaviness completes the earlier regime of blocked reception.

structural_cues: 18:57 accumulates turning away, forgetting, heart-coverings, and ear-weight against the focus's seeing and exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: refusal is described through blocked memory and perception, while the focus exposes land and gathers every person. Reader arrow: external disclosure defeats the earlier concealment strategy. Alternative: the coverings may describe a settled incapacity rather than a strategy reversed by the landscape scene.

changed_reading.before: The earth is physically visible after the mountains move.
changed_reading.after: Physical exposure also stages the defeat of evasion: what was turned from, forgotten, or enclosed becomes an unavoidable external field of presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus day is the expiry of granted delay: an appointed time arrives, inhabited refuges follow the same timed destruction pattern, and even mountain shelter is displaced before universal convergence.

activation_trace.role: A severe event embodied as a day supplies the terminal time boundary.
Entering mountain country supplies a potential refuge that the focus makes unstable.
Removal or expulsion makes the potential refuge unavailable.
Acceleration supplies the timing option explicitly withheld before the deadline.
A promise fixed to time or place identifies the delayed event as an appointment.
Flight to safety supplies the refuge option that is denied.
A settlement as gathered population supplies the inhabited shelter subjected to the pattern.
The paired destruction occurrences supply the realized endpoint of the appointment.
The repeated fixed appointment turns prior town destruction into a temporal analogue for the focus day.

structural_cues: 18:58 contrasts non-acceleration with an appointment and no refuge; 18:59 repeats appointment for destroyed settlements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: punishment is delayed to an appointment, refuge then fails, and settlements have timed destruction. Reader arrow: the focus day is delay expiring, while mountain removal gives temporal closure a spatial form. Alternative: failed refuge need not identify the mountains as shelter, and town appointments may be analogy rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The day is an unspecified future catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The day is a matured deadline: reprieve ends, inhabited and topographic refuges lose efficacy, and every person is brought in.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a crop-residue branch inside a human-gathering verb. It remains anchored by the focus's earth, gathering, and zero remainder plus 18:45's broken, scattered vegetation. Render it only as a material harvest analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 5-11: exposed earth, gathering, and no remainder.

activation_trace.role: Broken dry growth supplies the field's post-growth material state.
Winnowing by wind supplies removal of loose residue.
The post-harvest remainder branch supplies the odd gleaning image for the human gathering.
Negated residue left behind makes the imagined gleaning total.
The ground itself supplies the field on which the material analogy operates.

changed_reading.before: People are assembled on bare terrain.
changed_reading.after: The sequence admits a contained harvest image: growth is winnowed, persons are wholly gleaned, and no human residue remains on the exposed field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the mountain term into its branch for eminent communal figures. It remains anchored by explicit mountain displacement, individual exposure, and nearby failed patrons and helpers. Downstream prose should mark it as a social analogy beneath the literal topography, not identify the mountains outright with leaders.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mountain displacement followed by open exposure and the inclusion of every individual.

activation_trace.role: Eminent communal figures compared to mountains supply the possible social superstructure.
Displacement or expulsion removes that superstructure from its settled position.
Open exposure supplies the common field left after hierarchy is removed.
Protective loyalty and support supply the patronage relation that proves unreliable.
A strengthening helper supplies the support role explicitly refused in the surrounding sequence.
Individual singularity leaves each person exposed after support structures are leveled.

changed_reading.before: Only geological masses are displaced before the human gathering.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social resonance, monumental patrons and supports are displaced so every person appears without hierarchical shelter on the common field.

strongest_changes: Mountain motion becomes clearance that turns the earth into an exposed presentation and audit field.
Zero human remainder is paired with zero deed remainder, synchronizing persons and actions for inspection.
Universal co-presence intensifies individual isolation because support relations and escape routes fail.
The focus day becomes the expiry of delayed appointment, with settlement and topographic refuge losing efficacy.
summary.what_was_special: The packet linked macro-topographic stripping to ecological winnowing, public array, exhaustive record, and failed refuge while preserving harvest and social-leveling images as qualified outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The ecological stripping sequence may be an analogy of impermanence rather than a shared physical mechanism.
The link between mountain removal and loss of refuge is inferred rather than stated.
The harvest and social-support readings depend on branch-distant images and should remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Exposure abolishes exceptional escape.** `ء ح د` B001 (“oneness and absolute one”) appears under total negation: not one individual is left. Earlier “one of you” enters the city under concealment (18:19), but here individualized hiding is impossible. I infer that removal of mountains removes both material cover and imagined categorical exception. Judgment is comprehensive precisely at the level of each singular person.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:99’s turbulent mixture and total gathering completed the removal of every individual exception.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **No person can remain as terrain’s hidden remainder.** `غ د ر/B001` is leaving something behind; `غ د ر/B005` is rough ground left aside because it is hard to pass. Mountains are removed before the negation `لَمْ نُغَادِرْ`, and 18:48 arrays everyone in a row while 18:49 says the book leaves out neither small nor large. I infer that leveling space removes the physical analogue of selective omission. The ayah reads as exhaustive gathering made spatially visible: neither person nor hiding contour is left aside.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:48’s row and 18:49’s no-omission book confirmed that removing rough terrain is the spatial form of exhaustive inclusion.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek olma, mutlak biçimde eşsiz sayılma ve yinelemeyle bu niteliği pekiştirme çekirdeğini destekler. Aynı ifade saymanın ilk basamağına da değindiği için dal korunabilir, ancak düzenli sayı kurma kullanımları ayrı sayı dalına bırakılmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın bir tane, tek ya da eşi olmayan olmasıdır; mutlak kullanımda Tanrı'nın ortağı ve benzeri bulunmadığını bildirir. Sözcüğün yinelenmesi bu tekliği güçlü biçimde vurgular.

facets.statement: Bir varlığı bir tane, tek veya eşi bulunmayan olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün olumsuzluk içinde konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişilerin bütün türünü kapsadığını ve yalnız tek kişiyi değil iki ya da daha çok kişiyi de dışladığını açıkça belirtir. Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru yansıtır.

concept_map.definition: Olumsuz bir cümlede, söz konusu olabilecek kişilerden bir tekinin bile bulunmadığını ya da eyleme katılmadığını bildirir. Kapsam yalnız bir kişiyi değil, iki ve daha çok kişiyi de dışarıda bırakır.

facets.statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.
Bir kişinin yanı sıra iki veya daha çok kişinin varlığını ya da katılımını da dışlar.
Bir yerde hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını veya bir eylemi hiç kimsenin yapmadığını söyleyen cümlelerde gerçekleşir.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

source_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

tier_contracts.explicit_interest: Full source branch payload, except fields removed from all tiers.
tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
